# Toolstation

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Tool and building-supplies retailer with over 25,000 products and 550+ stores. Sells plumbing, electrical, hand and power tool accessories, lighting, ironmongery, fixings, workwear and heating supplies. Online orders deliver in mainland UK, with click and collect.
